source_evidence.captured_wording: passport size; 20KB; 200KB; jpg format; named photo; plain white; Shadows on the face or the background should not be there; at least 75%; area in the photo; both ears; head in the centre; Frontal view; Eyes must be open; avoid glare; no grinning; colour photo; NOT to be signed; live photo is mandatory
source_evidence.document_title: Instructions for Uploading Photo and Signature
source_evidence.section_name: Upload of Latest Passport Size Photograph / Capture of Live Photograph

dimensions.fallback_reason: No pixel dimensions are published by the conducting body. The output size is chosen per photograph from the crop geometry rather than from a fixed default.

spectacles.condition: Clear eyeglasses may be worn only without glare; dark/coloured glasses are unacceptable.

smile.condition: Natural expression required; grinning, frowning and raised eyebrows are prohibited.

image_requirements.file_size.evidence_reference: Instructions for Uploading Photo and Signature - Upload of Latest Passport Size Photograph / Capture of Live Photograph (https://upsconline.nic.in/ngrp/assets/PDF/instruction-photo-signature-upload-upsc.pdf)
image_requirements.file_size.reasoning: Byte ceiling converted from the published figure using 1 KB = 1000 bytes. No body in the researched set defines the unit, and the decimal reading is the smaller of the two, so a file satisfying it also satisfies a 1024-byte reading.

image_requirements.dimensions.reasoning: The conducting body publishes no pixel dimensions. The output size is chosen per photograph from the crop geometry, so no dimension is asserted on the body's behalf.

image_requirements.composition.crop_prof.reasoning: One composition is used for every examination: the tightest crop that keeps hair, ears and the chin/beard boundary intact. No researched body publishes a coverage maximum this would breach, and all published minima are cleared by it.
